items.text:
Welcome to the internal documentation for the payment service.

Tip

Good documentation explains the decisions, not just the API.

items.title: Quick example
items.text:
from decimal import Decimal

payment = Payment(amount=Decimal("49.95"), currency="EUR")

items.title: Provider interface
items.text:
from typing import Protocol
from decimal import Decimal

class PaymentProvider(Protocol):
    def charge(self, amount: Decimal) -> str:
        ...

items.title: Design note
items.text: We keep provider-specific code outside the domain model. That keeps the core payment logic independent from Stripe, Mollie, or any other provider.
